process.title: Discovery & Audit
process.description: We dive deep into your product, analyzing existing user flows, interviewing key stakeholders, and identifying immediate areas for churn reduction and UX improvements.

faq.question: How long does a typical SaaS design project take?
faq.answer: A standard SaaS redesign or new product design takes between 6 to 12 weeks. This includes deep discovery, UX architecture, UI design, and building a scalable design system.

faq.question: Do you also build the frontend (code)?
faq.answer: Yes. While our core is product design, we offer premium frontend implementation using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. We ensure the final coded product looks exactly like the Figma file.

faq.question: How do you ensure the design actually improves metrics?
faq.answer: We don't design based on guesswork. We conduct thorough UX audits, interview your users, analyze heatmaps, and rely on proven UX patterns that specifically reduce friction and churn.

faq.question: What do we receive at the end of the project?
faq.answer: You receive a highly organized Figma file containing all screens, prototypes, and a comprehensive Design System (components, tokens, guidelines) ready for your engineers to use.

faq.question: Can you integrate with our existing engineering team?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We act as an extension of your team. We maintain tight feedback loops and provide detailed technical handoffs so your engineers are never left guessing.
